comment: A Tourist with 10 hit points breaks a wished-for wand of fire in debug mode and answers y at Die?. apply.c broken_wand_explode() calls explode(), whose fatal damage reaches end.c done(); C's done() never returns, so neither makeknown() nor discard_broken_wand() runs and no further random number is drawn. Answering q at the disclosure prompt and n at Save bones? ends the game.
